positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Snowflake: Migration of data from Hive, maintenance multiple pipelines, and adherence to data governance principles.
- Container-orchestration: Management of existing projects using docker-compose on EC2, with compliance to relevant frameworks.
- Flask: Bringing projects to Python 3 while warranting no downtime for our stakeholders.
- Stakeholder management: Developing multiple projects on my own, from start to finish with minimal supervision, and ensuring PII data protection policies.
- Management: Mentor and monitor, improving code and communication skills, with a deep understanding of data security best practices.
- Airflow: Owner of multiple DAGs ranging from SOX reporting to external API consumption, maintaining the DAGs for the team, ensuring consistency, and experience with software development in applied cryptography.
- React: With typescript migrate, mantain and update diverse projects, allowing experiences for all pinployess to feel as awesome as Pinterest itself

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.locationName: Ciudad de México y alrededores, México
positions.description:
• Airflow: Analyzed and processed huge amounts of data (over 54_000_000 files of clients) to stream the information in the fastest way possible to the risk team.
• Dash-Plotly: With dash by plotly development of front-end applications to quickly present relevant without the need of front-end developers.
• Pandas: Completed numerous projects with end-goal of producing a framework for recurring standardized reports.
• ETL, SQL, PostgreSQL: Serve these reports on demand and almost real-time with Airflow as an ETL.
• OpenCV: Transform the Mexican tax returns into excel documents with reliable information and ready to use.
• Jenkins, ECR, ECS: Implementation of CI/CD.
• Docker: Standardization of libraries to prevent conflicts and make development faster.
• Unit Test: All code created by me, and for legacy code with this technical debt.
 Pip packages: Creation of internal libraries to be distributed across multiple applications.
Leadership: Mentoring of junior staff (Ben Tovar) and leadership of projects inside the company. 

All of this accomplished by my squad https://www.linkedin.com/in/gustavo-vera-velasco-6651b8122/(leader),  https://www.linkedin.com/in/tulio-espinosa-rodr%C3%ADguez-9768baa1/,   https://www.linkedin.com/in/jafet-gonzalez-castillo-4625b6117/

positions.title: Chief Of Development
positions.locationName: Ciudad de México y alrededores, México
positions.description:
• Leadership: Recruit the team, leading of the culture we would follow, as well as all the practices would use
• AWS: DevOps of the cloud infrastructure
• AWS Rekognition: Lead the development of facial recognition system for AT&T physical towers
• Linux: On-site deployment of OpenALPR technologies across all Mexican-US border
• Machine Learning, MongoDB: Retraining and implementation of a neural network to predict client patterns on convenience stores

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
A project during school that allowed me to pay for the last year and a half of my education. We got over $5,000,000 from Telcel.

Details -> https://medium.com/@jsanchezcastillejos/how-i-stole-5-500-000-mexican-pesos-from-carlos-slim-8da3ff365082
